description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국 예금상품 정보조회 서비스 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 현재 우체국에서 취급하는 예금상품에 관한 정보입니다. 해당데이터가 보유한 컬럼은 다음과 같습니다. 컬럼명: 상품명, 카드발급 여부, 인터넷 가입가능 여부, 이율 사용자가 응답받게 되는 데이터는 다음과 같습니다. 호출데이터: 상품명, 카드발급 여부, 인터넷 가입가능 여부, 이율. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 경제/경영, 거시경제, 금융(화폐)경제, 재정금융. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2023-02-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
